activity.notes: Gojong assumed the imperial title in October 1897 and ruled the Korean Empire until Japan forced his abdication in 1907. ATLAS records this as a separate sovereign Activity from his earlier kingship of Joseon, preserving the real polity and title transition.

sources.title: 고종 — 한국민족문화대백과사전
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture identifies Gojong as the first emperor of the Korean Empire and records his rule through forced abdication in 1907.

sources.title: 국호를 대한으로 하고 임금을 황제로 칭한다고 선포하다 — 조선왕조실록
sources.citation_text: The Veritable Records for 13 October 1897 record the proclamation of Daehan and the imperial title.
